# Team rules

- Keep answers short and in plain English. Explain only when asked.
- Map: shared shapes `contracts/api.py` · API `backend/app/` · predictions `backend/app/model.py` · ML `ml/predict.py` · plan `PLAN.md`.
- Backend: Python, FastAPI, Pydantic. Don't add new libraries without asking.
- Change `contracts/` only with the lead.
- Never put secrets, API keys or personal data (phone numbers, emails) in code, logs or AI prompts.
- Stay inside the files of your task.
- Team commands: `hk help`. Start the API: `hk run`.
